title: Sign up for a 1Password Family account
issue: Sign up for a 1Password Family account
resolution_html:
Each York user with a 1Password Enterprise account is also provided with a complimentary 1Password Family account that can be shared with up to 5 other people. To redeem your free Family account:

  1. Sign in to your business account
  2. Click on your name in the top right corner of the page, and select My Profile
  3. You should see a "Claim your free family account" section. Click on Redeem Now

For more detailed instructions, please visit https://support.1password.com/link-family/
